title: Bad Bunny Arrives in New York City Ahead of 2026 Met Gala
detail: Bad Bunny was photographed in New York City on April 30, 2026, keeping a notably low profile in casual attire (gray hoodie, jeans, green cap) ahead of the 2026 Met Gala on May 4. Just Jared published the sighting on May 1. Latination had confirmed his expected attendance since March 18, citing guest committee sources that placed him among the event's highest-profile expected attendees alongside Sabrina Carpenter. Bad Bunny has attended the Met Gala since 2022 and is consistently recognized for boundary-pushing fashion choices. His appearance comes at the height of his global momentum: "DtMF" logging a record 57 consecutive weeks at No. 1 on Hot Latin Songs, a Grammy Album of the Year win, and the European leg of the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour opening May 22 in Barcelona.
